subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Today women of our (i) the worst sufferer. country have started contributing (b) Women are (ii) the least sufferer. (c) Women cannot play (iii) are highly educated. (d) Women's (iv) to their family income. participation in decision making (e) Most of the women (v) are deprived of the light of education. (vi) any vital role in decision making. (vii) is essential to remove gender discrimination.
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iv) Today women of our country have started contributing to their family income. (b) + (i) Women are the worst sufferers. (c) + (vi) Women cannot play any vital role in decision making. (d) + (vii) Women's participation in decision making is essential to remove gender discrimination (e) + (v) Most of the women are deprived of the light of education.
